ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 92% low-intensity dark pixels versus 8% high-intensity white pixels localized at the tips and in linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface is a continuous low-intensity dark field. High-contrast white clusters are mapped to the extreme distal tips (far left and far right). Linear high-intensity pixel disruptions are mapped across the mid-surface of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth is relatively shallow.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire length of the trailing edge; irregular peak-to-valley spacing isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges show a concave curve originating from the median notch, sweeping upward to convex distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the far right distal tip and the upper left edge tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant density of white, non-parallel linear streaks (rake marks) on the left lobe; less dense but present on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the central-left fluke surface and barnacle-attachment scarring at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The lower-central region of the left lobe is occluded by high-intensity white pixels representing water foam/turbulence.
